name: Strong Signal: Maximum Amplitude
description: Maximize the oscillation amplitude. Observe how the field arrows grow longer and the wave envelope becomes more pronounced. Amplitude controls signal strength -- important for understanding why radio signals weaken with distance.

successCriteria.description: Observe large field arrows at maximum amplitude

hints.message: Maximum amplitude = strongest signal. The field arrows are at their largest.
In real radio transmission, higher amplitude = more power = longer range.
